tutorial.pick: First, the Pick phase. Take the two blind cards to become the 'picker', or pass.
tutorial.bury: As the picker, choose two cards from your hand to bury. Their points count for you.
tutorial.call: Choose a called suit; whoever holds that ace becomes your hidden partner.
tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. Follow the led suit; trumps (Queens, Jacks, diamonds) decide strength.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a card to select it.
tutorial.playButton: After selecting a card, play it with this button.
tutorial.info: Card points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2. Of the 120 total, the picker team wins by taking 61+. Chips move on each result.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
